features.name: Snapshot retention coverage matrix

The component × capability matrix records unit/UI ownership and explicit gaps. `./scripts/module ci ios-xq-fitness-app` passed the generic build and all 17 host tests; XCResult reports 5 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped on iPhone 12 / iOS 26.5.
